title: 第5章 地道逃走第6章 地下室
content_zh:
“卧槽。”易长生听到田家大小姐的话后在心里大骂鸟语。
看不出来，真的看不出来这个外表温和善良田家大小姐是这样的人。
还有她抓孤儿干什么？
易长生扫了一眼田家那边的武者侍卫，他心里有点慌，他自己就是孤儿的一份子啊。
眼看着快到他领馒头，他收起虚维之眼，等领了馒头后，就跑到田家的队伍后面去。
他没打算再领田家的肉粥，只是想借着人群挡住他瘦小的身影，趁着田家那些武者侍卫不注意的时候，立即窜进小树林里。
一进入树林，他躲躲藏藏地远离官道。
逃，赶紧逃，易长生可不想被那大小姐的侍卫抓去毒哑。
而且还不知道田大家小姐毒哑他们这些孤儿后，还会怎么对他们？
不过，要逃到哪里去？
等看不到其他人的身影时，易长生想了想，他跑回之前虚维之眼发现异样的位置。
之前在这里他看到地下似乎有一个地洞，因为武者的到来他没来得及细看。
他在地上找了一个石子，把虚维之眼放置到石子上，拿在手中，找准之前的位置用虚维之眼细看地下。
仔细观察之下，地下并不是地洞，似乎是一条人工开挖的地道，离地面有三米深左右。
这距离虚维之眼的全知视角已经模糊，难怪之前看不清。
他观察了一下地道的方向，似乎是从县城那边过来，直到这边，而另一边似乎是往小山坡那边去。
易长生拿着虚维之眼顺着地道往小山坡的方向查看。
没过多久，他就找到了地道的出入口。
就是在小山坡的另一面，出口藏得挺隐秘的，外面还有很多大石块草丛小树挡着，要不是有虚维之眼的全知视角查看，他都不会发现这个出入口。
易长生看了一眼周围没人，小心翼翼的进入地道，尽量别留下踩踏痕迹。

钻进地道后，他把出口的树枝和草丛尽量还原，不让人轻易发现出入口。
等做完这些，易长生才狠狠地松了一口气。
他无力地靠在洞壁上歇着。
等剧烈的心跳和气息平复后，他才缓缓地站起来，往地道里面走。
地道不大，往下坡走，高宽都在一米五左右，大人的话需要弯着腰才能在里面行走。
易长生现在还是个十岁的小孩，他直起腰上头上还有很多空位。
这里面黑漆漆的，走进里面一点的话，伸手不见五指，还好他有虚维之眼。
他把虚维之眼放在手上伸到前面，小心翼翼的一边观察一边往里面走。
偶尔地道离地面近时，虚维之眼还能观察到地表上面的情况，只是远了就会模糊。
没过多久，易长生就来到了发现地道的位置，他观察了一下地表上，虚维之眼范围太小了，看不到什么了。
外面的天色已经开始昏暗起来，他没多停留，继续往地道深处的方向走。
他走的很慢走得很小心，就怕地道里会有陷阱或是蛇虫鼠蚁之类的。
走了一个多时辰，地道弯弯曲曲，有时是往上坡走，有时是往下坡，易长生也不知道走了有多远。
还好地道里没有分岔，倒不会让他迷路，也没有遇到陷阱，蛇虫鼠蚁也没看到，就是发现了一些蜘蛛网。
偶尔遇到上坡路还能看到通风口的位置，到了这种地方他就会用虚维之眼观察一下地表外面，只是外面已经天黑了，也看不到什么有用的信息。
content_en:
"Fuck you." Yi Changsheng cursed in his heart after hearing what the eldest daughter of the Tian family said.
I can't tell, I really can't tell that this gentle and kind-hearted eldest lady of the Tian family is such a person.
And why is she catching orphans?
Yi Changsheng glanced at the warrior guards on the Tian family's side. He felt a little panicked. He himself was one of the orphans.
Seeing that it was almost time for him to receive the steamed buns, he put away his Xuwei Eyes, and after receiving the steamed buns, he ran behind the Tian family's team.
He had no intention of receiving any more meat porridge from the Tian family. He just wanted to use the crowd to block his thin figure, and immediately ran into the woods when the warrior guards of the Tian family were not paying attention.
Once he entered the woods, he hid away from the official road.
Run away, run away quickly, Yi Changsheng doesn't want to be caught and mute by the eldest lady's guards.
And I don’t know what Miss Tian will do to these orphans after she poisoned them.
But where to escape?
When no one else could be seen, Yi Changsheng thought for a while and ran back to the location where the Xuwei Eye noticed something strange.
He saw what seemed to be a cave underground here before, but he didn't have time to take a closer look because of the warrior's arrival.
He found a stone on the ground, placed the Eye of Xuwei on the stone, held it in his hand, found the previous position and used the Eye of Xuwei to look at the ground carefully.
Upon closer inspection, it appears that the underground is not a cave, but an artificially excavated tunnel about three meters deep from the ground.
This distance from the omniscient perspective of the Eye of Virtual Dimension has become blurry, so no wonder it couldn’t be seen clearly before.
He observed the direction of the tunnel. It seemed to be coming from the county seat to this side, while the other side seemed to be heading towards the hillside.
Yi Changsheng took the Eye of Xuwei and looked along the tunnel towards the hillside.
It didn't take long for him to find the entrance and exit of the tunnel.
On the other side of the hillside, the exit was quite hidden. There were many large rocks, grass and small trees blocking the outside. If it weren't for the omniscient perspective of the Eye of Xuwei, he would not have discovered this entrance.
Yi Changsheng took a look and saw that there was no one around, then entered the tunnel cautiously, trying not to leave any traces of trampling.
After getting into the tunnel, he restored the branches and grass at the exit as much as possible so that no one could easily find the entrance and exit.
After finishing this, Yi Changsheng breathed a sigh of relief.
He rested weakly against the cave wall.
After his violent heartbeat and breath calmed down, he slowly stood up and walked into the tunnel.
The tunnel is not big and goes downhill. It is about 1.5 meters high and 1.5 meters wide. Adults need to bend down to walk in it.
Yi Changsheng is still a ten-year-old child now. When he straightens his waist, there is still a lot of space on his head.
It's pitch dark inside. If you walk a little deeper inside, you won't be able to see your fingers. Fortunately, he has the Eye of Virtual Reality.
He put the Eye of Xuwei in his hand and stretched it forward, observing carefully while walking inside.
Occasionally when the tunnel is close to the ground, the Eye of Virtual Dimension can still observe the situation above the surface, but it will be blurry when it is far away.
It didn't take long for Yi Changsheng to arrive at the location where the tunnel was discovered. He looked at the surface and found that the scope of the Eye of Xuwei was too small to see anything.
The sky outside had begun to darken, so he continued walking deeper into the tunnel without stopping.
He walked very slowly and carefully, fearing that there would be traps or snakes, insects, rats, ants, etc. in the tunnel.
After walking for more than an hour, the tunnel was winding, sometimes going uphill, sometimes going downhill. Yi Changsheng didn't know how far he had walked.
Fortunately, there were no branches in the tunnel, so he wouldn't get lost, and he didn't encounter any traps, snakes, insects, rats, or ants. He just found some spider webs.
Occasionally, he could still see the location of the vent when he encountered an uphill road. When he reached such a place, he would use the Eye of Virtual Dimension to observe the outside of the surface. However, it was already dark outside and he could not see any useful information.
